context: A coach checks in with the athlete
purpose: Coach the athlete; teach 競技/スキル/マシン/エリア/必死/武器/神経/競馬

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日の競技、調子ええで。
lines.style: Kansai coach approving warmly, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スキルが伸びてる気がします。
lines.en: My skills feel like they’re growing.
lines.style: athlete reporting, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あのマシン、もっと使い込んでみ。
lines.style: coach directing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 奥のエリア、空いてますか？
lines.style: athlete asking, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 空いとるで。必死さが伝わってくるわ。
lines.en: It’s open. Your fierce drive comes through.
lines.style: coach reading him, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 持久力を、自分の武器にしたいです。
lines.en: I want endurance as my weapon.
lines.style: athlete naming his aim, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 神経の使い方も、訓練やで。
lines.en: How you use your nerves is training too.
lines.style: coach teaching mental side, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 競馬で言うサラブレッドみたいに、磨きたいです。
lines.en: Like a thoroughbred in horse racing, I want to polish.
lines.style: athlete drawing a vivid parallel, tone holding steady through the whole line
